# Borrowed code (vendor)

These files were written by other people. They are copied here **unchanged**, so the site
never has to fetch anything from another website while running.

| File | What it does for us | Author / licence |
|---|---|---|
| `pdollar.js` | Recognises shapes someone draws (triangle, cross, spiral…) | $P Point-Cloud Recognizer, University of Washington — New BSD (licence text is at the top of the file) |
| `cursor-effects.browser.js` | The fairy-dust sparkles that follow the mouse | cursor-effects 1.0.18 by Tim Holman — MIT (`cursor-effects.LICENSE`) |
| `oneko.js`, `oneko.gif` | The little pixel cat that chases the mouse | oneko.js by adryd — MIT (`oneko.LICENSE`) |
| `fonts/` | The fonts of the letter inside the scroll | Grenze Gotisch, Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond — SIL Open Font License ([fonts/README.md](fonts/README.md)) |

To update one: download the new version over the old file and check the page still works.
